name: keenable-select
description: Ask a question of the live web and get a table back. Keenable SELECT runs many searches, reads the pages and extracts the fields you need in one call. Sign in with a Keenable account.
suggestedPrompts: Which open-source vector databases come up most in 2026 comparisons? Give me a table with license, latest version and a source for each
